title: 1 Thessalonians Bible Quiz - Chapter 4
description: Ten questions on 1 Thessalonians 4: the call to sanctification and quiet work, and the words about those who have fallen asleep.

questions.text: What does verse 3 call the will of God?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 says this is the will of God: their sanctification, that they abstain from sexual immorality.

questions.text: Who are described as living in the passion of lust?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 contrasts controlling one's own body with the passion of lust, even as the Gentiles who don't know God.

answers.text: The Gentiles who don't know God

questions.text: What does verse 6 say the Lord is in all these things?
questions.explanation: No one should take advantage of and wrong a brother or sister in this matter, because the Lord is an avenger in all these things.

questions.text: According to verse 8, whom does the one who rejects this reject?
questions.explanation: Verse 8 says he who rejects this doesn't reject man, but God, who has also given his Holy Spirit to them.

questions.text: In which region do they already show brotherly love toward all the brothers?
questions.explanation: Verse 10 says that indeed they do it toward all the brothers who are in all Macedonia.

questions.text: What were they to make their ambition, according to verse 11?
questions.explanation: Verse 11 tells them to make it their ambition to lead a quiet life, to do their own business, and to work with their own hands.

answers.text: To preach in every city of Macedonia
To gather money for the poor in Judea
To lead a quiet life and work with their own hands
To keep the feasts and the new moons

questions.text: How were they not to grieve for those who have fallen asleep?
questions.explanation: Verse 13 says they should not grieve like the rest, who have no hope.

answers.text: Not in the sight of the Gentiles
Not like the rest, who have no hope

questions.text: With what will the Lord himself descend from heaven?
questions.explanation: Verse 16 says the Lord himself will descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel and with God's trumpet.

answers.text: With a book in his hand
With a shout and God's trumpet

questions.text: Who will rise first when the Lord descends?
questions.explanation: Verse 16 says the dead in Christ will rise first; then those who are alive and left will be caught up with them.

answers.text: Those who are alive and left

questions.text: What are they to do with these words, according to verse 18?
questions.explanation: Verse 18 says: therefore comfort one another with these words.

answers.text: Read them only at his coming
